mapper.sql: select o.id, o.order_no, o.order_type, o.order_date, o.seller_id, o.seller_contact_id, o.seller_snapshot, o.buyer_id, o.buyer_snapshot, o.currency, o.total_amount, o.status, o.remark, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time, s.supplier_name as seller_name from crm_order o left join crm_supplier s on s.id = o.seller_id
mapper.insert: insert into crm_order( order_no, order_type, order_date, seller_id, seller_contact_id, seller_snapshot, buyer_id, buyer_snapshot, currency, total_amount, status, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) values ( #{orderNo}, #{orderType}, #{orderDate}, #{sellerId}, #{sellerContactId}, #{sellerSnapshot}, #{buyerId}, #{buyerSnapshot}, #{currency}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now() )
mapper.delete: delete from crm_order where id in #{id}
mapper.select: select seq_val from crm_order_seq where seq_key = #{seqKey} for update
mapper.insert: insert into crm_order_seq(seq_key, seq_val, update_time) values (#{seqKey}, 0, now())
mapper.update: update crm_order_seq set seq_val = seq_val + 1, update_time = now() where seq_key = #{seqKey}
